question: Bima Vistaar, an insurance product covering life, health and property for rural people, is likely to be launched by ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**December 2025**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Bima Vistaar** is an innovative, all-in-one bundled insurance product designed by the **Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI)** to provide comprehensive coverage for **life**, **health**, and **property**.
 
• According to the latest announcements by **IRDAI** officials, the product is likely to be launched by **December 2025**. This timeline aligns with the development of the necessary digital and physical infrastructure required for mass distribution.
 
• The scheme is specifically tailored for the **rural population** of India, aiming to provide a simple and affordable safety net against various risks in a single policy document.
